run_covost_data_prep: run the script to prepare CoVoST speech-to-text data with source and target language arguments
create_covost_dataset: create a CoVoST PyTorch Dataset instance for a given language pair and train dev or test split
extract_fbank_features: extract log mel filter bank features from audio waveforms and save them as numpy arrays
generate_manifest_tsv: generate a TSV manifest file with audio IDs, frame counts, target text, and speaker info
build_vocab_model: build a sentencepiece vocab model from training text using bpe, unigram, or char tokenization
